[SWS_Sd_00331]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00161
⌈In the Repetition Phase up to SdServerTimerInitialOfferRepetitionsMax OfferService
Entries shall be sent with doubling intervals (BaseDelay, first OfferService Entries, 2x
BaseDelay, second OfferService Entries, 4x BaseDelay, third OfferService Entries).⌋
Note: Example config and resulting behavior:
SdServerTimerInitialOfferRepetitionBaseDelay=30
SdServerTimerInitialOfferRepetitionsMax=3
[Initial Wait Phase starts]
Wait Initial Wait Delay based on Configured Min and Max
Send entry.
[Initial Wait Phase ends]
[Repetition Phase starts]
Wait 30ms (=30ms * 20).
Send entry.
Wait 60ms (=30ms * 21).
Send entry.
Wait 120ms (=30ms * 22).
Send entry.
